parameters.jsCode: const out=[];for(const item of $input.all()){const d=item.json;const errors=[];if(!d.title)errors.push('title is required');if(!d.objective)errors.push('objective is required');if(!d.description)errors.push('description is required');if(!['HIGH','MEDIUM','LOW'].includes(d.priority))errors.push('priority invalid');if(!Array.isArray(d.evidence))errors.push('evidence must be an array');out.push({json:{...d,is_valid:errors.length===0,validation_errors:errors}});}return out;
